title: NimbleBrain Configuration
description: Configuration file for the NimbleBrain agent runtime (nimblebrain.json).

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference URI. Should be "https://schemas.nimblebrain.ai/v1/nimblebrain-config.schema.json".

apiKey.description: Anthropic API key. Falls back to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var. May instead be a credential reference — { "ref": "credential", "key": "<key>" } — resolved from the instance scope of the credential store at startup, so the value never sits in this file. See /config/secrets/.

Provider API key. May instead be a credential reference — { "ref": "credential", "key": "<key>" } — resolved from the instance scope of the credential store at startup, so the value never sits in this file. See /config/secrets/.

models.description: Allowlist of model IDs. Omit to allow all.

apiKey.description: Provider API key. May instead be a credential reference — { "ref": "credential", "key": "<key>" } — resolved from the instance scope of the credential store at startup, so the value never sits in this file. See /config/secrets/.

models.description: Allowlist of model IDs. Omit to allow all.

apiKey.description: Provider API key. May instead be a credential reference — { "ref": "credential", "key": "<key>" } — resolved from the instance scope of the credential store at startup, so the value never sits in this file. See /config/secrets/.

models.description: Allowlist of model IDs. Omit to allow all.

nebius.description: Nebius Token Factory — OpenAI-compatible gateway for open-weight models. Reference models as nebius:<model-id>.

apiKey.description: Nebius API key. Falls back to NEBIUS_API_KEY env var. May instead be a credential reference — { "ref": "credential", "key": "<key>" } — resolved from the instance scope of the credential store at startup, so the value never sits in this file. See /config/secrets/.

baseURL.description: Override the inference endpoint. Default: https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1

models.description: Allowlist of model IDs. Omit to allow all.

xai.description: xAI (Grok). Reference models as xai:<model-id>, e.g. xai:grok-4.5.

apiKey.description: xAI API key. Falls back to XAI_API_KEY env var. May instead be a credential reference — { "ref": "credential", "key": "<key>" } — resolved from the instance scope of the credential store at startup, so the value never sits in this file. See /config/secrets/.

baseURL.description: Override the inference endpoint. Default: https://api.x.ai/v1

models.description: Allowlist of model IDs. Omit to allow all.

allowInsecureRemotes.description: Allow HTTP (non-TLS) remote connector connections. Dev only.

modelPolicy.description: Which models this organization permits. Absent or empty allows every chat-capable model from every configured provider.

allowed.description: Qualified provider:model-id strings. Can only subtract from what the configured providers can reach.

defaultModel.description: Default model ID (e.g., "claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929"). Deprecated — use models.default instead.

maxIterations.description: Max agentic iterations per request. Capped at 50. Default: 25.

maxInputTokens.description: Max input tokens per request. Default: 500000.

maxOutputTokens.description: Max output tokens per LLM call. Default: 16384.

thinking.description: Extended-thinking mode. off: do not reason (not enforceable on every model). adaptive: model decides per call. enabled: reason every turn, at thinkingEffort.

thinkingEffort.description: How hard to think when reasoning is on. The portable control — every reasoning-capable provider can express a depth. Default: medium.

thinkingBudgetTokens.description: Explicit token budget for thinking. Only honored by providers that meter thinking in tokens (Anthropic up to 4.6, Gemini 2.5); elsewhere thinkingEffort applies. Anthropic requires a minimum of 1024.

maxToolResultSize.description: Max chars for a single tool result. Results exceeding this are replaced with an error. 0 disables. Default: 1000000.

disabled.description: Disable structured logging entirely. Default: false.

level.description: Logging verbosity level. 'debug' persists verbose fields (system prompt, tool inputs/outputs, full message history) to conversation files. Default: normal.

retentionDays.description: Auto-delete log files older than N days on startup. Default: no cleanup.

http.description: HTTP server config. Omit for programmatic-only use.

port.description: Port number for the HTTP server. Default: 27247.

workDir.description: Working directory for all runtime state. Defaults to ~/.nimblebrain.

usage.description: Durable usage ledger: one JSONL line per priced LLM call, under {workDir}/usage/<YYYY-MM>/. The single source for tenant-level spend reporting.

enabled.description: Write the ledger. Default true. False stops new lines; the reader still reads what is already there.

retentionMonths.description: Months of history to keep. 0 keeps everything. Month directories older than the window are deleted when the writer is constructed, so a process that outlives the window sweeps on its next restart.

sessionStore.description: MCP session metadata store for /mcp. Tracks each Mcp-Session-Id and its idle TTL. Default: in-memory (process-local). Use 'redis' for multi-replica deploys; the same provider also gives single-replica deploys cluster-wide visibility for ops/admin tooling.

type.description: Provider. 'memory' is process-local (default). 'redis' is cluster-shared (required for platform.replicas > 1).

ttlSeconds.description: Idle TTL for sessions in seconds. Each request resets the clock — actively-used sessions never expire. Default: 28800 (8 h).

url.description: Redis connection URL (redis:// or rediss://). Typically injected via environment from a secret.

keyPrefix.description: Hash key prefix for session entries. Default: 'nb:mcp:session:'.

secrets.description: Which backend holds the deployment's secrets. Omit the block for the default: one plaintext file per secret under the work directory. See /config/secrets/.

backend.description: Registered credential-store backend name. Default: "file". An unregistered name fails startup rather than falling back — a deployment that asked for one backend and silently got plaintext files is the outcome this refuses.

config.description: That backend's own settings, passed through verbatim. MUST NOT contain key material: this file is commonly rendered from a values file in version control, so a key written here is a key committed to a repository. Name an environment variable instead — a property whose name ends in "Env" holds the NAME of one.

telemetry.description: Anonymous usage telemetry. Disable with telemetry.enabled: false, NB_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1, or DO_NOT_TRACK=1.

features.description: Feature flags to enable/disable capabilities. All default to true. Set to false to disable.

skillManagement.description: Enable the skill write surface via the nb__skills tools: create, update, delete, history, restore, set_status, and the conversation-scoped activate/deactivate. Default: true.

toolDiscovery.description: Enable tool search via nb__search scope=tools. Default: true.

catalogSearch.description: Enable catalog search via nb__search scope=catalog. Default: true.

fileContext.description: Enable file context (workspace files, chat attachments). Default: true.

userManagement.description: Enable user create/delete via nb__manage_users (admin only). Default: true.

workspaceManagement.description: Enable workspace CRUD and member management via nb__manage_workspaces (admin only). Default: true.

compaction.description: Enable conversation compaction at run start to bound context growth. Default: true.

connectors.description: Connector integration configuration. `providers` declares managed-connector providers, which broker auth and host MCP sessions on the tenant's behalf. `gateways` declares hosted-MCP vendors that broker nothing and authenticate with one account-wide API key.

providers.description: Declared providers, keyed by the connector auth-kind each owns. A provider is registered — and its routes, liveness probe, and vendor SDK reached — only when its broker credential is present. Settings resolve from the block only; the broker credential also reads its <VENDOR>_API_KEY env var.

composio.description: Composio (auth broker + hosted MCP sessions). Settings resolve from this block only; the broker credential also falls back to COMPOSIO_API_KEY. Per-toolkit auth-config ids live in authConfigs.

apiKey.description: Platform-wide Composio API key — the broker credential, and the gate on registering the provider at all. Falls back to COMPOSIO_API_KEY. A secret in a mounted config file is the operator's call; the env fallback remains the better posture for most deployments. May instead be a credential reference — { "ref": "credential", "key": "<key>" } — resolved from the instance scope of the credential store at startup, so the value never sits in this file. See /config/secrets/.

authConfigs.description: Per-toolkit Composio auth-config ids (`ac_…`), keyed by the toolkit slug the catalog entry already names — {"gmail": "ac_xyz"}. Non-secret identifiers (inert without apiKey) that vary per Composio account, which is why they are declared per deployment rather than carried in the shared catalog.

baseUrl.description: Composio API base URL override (self-hosted / staging). Must be http(s). Default: https://backend.composio.dev

monitorEnabled.description: Run Composio's arm of the connection-revalidator probe, which polls for connections whose downstream vendor account lapsed while the platform key stayed valid. Default: true when the provider is configured. The sweep cadence is provider-agnostic and is set via NB_CONNECTION_REVALIDATE_INTERVAL_SECONDS, not here.

smithery.description: Smithery (auth broker + hosted MCP sessions). Settings resolve from this block only; the broker credential also falls back to SMITHERY_API_KEY. The provider registers only when both a credential and a namespace resolve.

apiKey.description: Platform-wide Smithery API key. Falls back to SMITHERY_API_KEY. Its presence (with a namespace) is the gate on registering the provider at all. May instead be a credential reference — { "ref": "credential", "key": "<key>" } — resolved from the instance scope of the credential store at startup, so the value never sits in this file. See /config/secrets/.

namespace.description: Smithery namespace brokered connections are created under. Globally unique and account-owned, so there is no default — without it the provider stays unregistered even with a credential present.

baseUrl.description: Connect API base URL override. Must be http(s) — the session URL derived from it becomes an installed connector's remote MCP target. Default: https://api.smithery.ai

monitorEnabled.description: Run Smithery's arm of the connection-revalidator probe. It detects a connection deleted at the broker; a lapsed authorization is logged, not flipped, until a verdict can carry a remedy URL. Default: true when the provider is configured. The sweep cadence is provider-agnostic and is set via NB_CONNECTION_REVALIDATE_INTERVAL_SECONDS, not here.

gateways.description: Hosted-MCP gateways, keyed by the operator-chosen name an `auth: provider` catalog entry names in providerAuth.provider. Declaring one registers a credential provider under that name which attaches the key as `Authorization: Bearer`. Names reserved by built-in credential providers (minted, composio, smithery) are refused.

apiKey.description: The gateway's account-wide API key. Falls back to <NAME>_API_KEY (name upper-cased, non-alphanumerics to underscore), so `mcp360` reads MCP360_API_KEY. May instead be a credential reference — { "ref": "credential", "key": "<key>" } — resolved from the instance scope of the credential store at startup, so the value never sits in this file. See /config/secrets/.

notifications.description: Notifications — how the runtime reads the outboxes connectors declare. Only the poll's pacing is configurable: what an outbox carries is the emitting server's decision and who may declare one is the operator's, while what the poll costs is the runtime's.

poll.description: Pacing for the outbox poll. Cadence is per (workspace, connector) and adaptive: consecutive empty polls double the interval up to maxIntervalMs, and a poll that returns events snaps back to intervalMs. A server may recommend its own cadence with nextPollMs, honoured between a fixed 15s floor and maxIntervalMs.

intervalMs.description: Base cadence per source, in milliseconds. Floored at the fixed 15000 ms poll floor. Default: 60000 (60s).

maxIntervalMs.description: Backoff ceiling in milliseconds — the slowest an idle source is read, and the interval an open circuit breaker half-opens on. Never resolves below intervalMs. Default: 300000 (5 min).

maxEvents.description: Events requested per read. A server that cuts the batch at this size answers hasMore, and the runtime reads again at once within the budget. Capped at 1000. Default: 100.

budgetPerMinute.description: Polls allowed per workspace per minute, across every connector in it. Sources beyond the budget are deferred to the next tick in round-robin order, never starved. The default derives from the edge limiter: a quarter of a tenant's 120 rpm, at three requests per poll (a reconnect costs initialize + initialized + the read). Default: 10.

files.description: File context configuration for workspace file uploads.

maxFileSize.description: Maximum individual file size in bytes. Default: 26214400 (25 MB).

maxTotalSize.description: Maximum total file size per message in bytes. Default: 104857600 (100 MB).

maxFilesPerMessage.description: Maximum number of files per chat message. Default: 10.

maxExtractedTextSize.description: Maximum extracted text size per file in bytes. Default: 204800 (200 KB).

brand.description: White-label branding: the product name, logos, palette, typefaces and corner radius a tenant's users see in place of NimbleBrain's. Every key is optional, and an absent block is NimbleBrain. The runtime rejects at load a palette that fails any WCAG AA contrast pair the canonical palette is held to. Served unauthenticated at GET /v1/brand. See https://docs.nimblebrain.ai/config/branding/.

name.description: Product name shown in place of "NimbleBrain": the agent's identity line, OAuth consent screens, the OAuth success page, error pages. Default: "NimbleBrain".

homepageUrl.description: Homepage sent as `client_uri` when registering OAuth clients with connector vendors.

logo.description: Logo artwork URLs. A URL that is set must resolve; a broken URL renders a broken image, not the default logo.

mark.description: Square mark, used where the full logo does not fit.

raster.description: PNG mark sent as `logo_uri` in OAuth client registration. Raster because several identity providers refuse SVG there.

colors.description: Palette overrides by token name, each a [light, dark] pair of #rrggbb values. An omitted <x>-foreground whose <x> is set is derived as white or black, whichever reads better.

fonts.description: Typeface overrides per role. A family with no url or faces must be a system font.

radius.description: Corner radius scale overrides, as CSS lengths.

brandFontUrl.description: A woff2 font file. Not a stylesheet: Google Fonts CSS URLs are rejected.

brandFontWeight.description: CSS font-weight descriptor: "400", or a variable range "400 700".

brandFont.description: One typeface role. `url` (+ `weight`) declares one face, typical for a variable font; `faces` declares several static ones. Not both.

family.description: Family name the faces are declared under. Required with url or faces.

connectorRef.description: One entry in a workspace's `connectors[]` — a remote MCP server, addressed by URL. Workspace records live at `<workDir>/workspaces/<wsId>/workspace.json`, not in this file.

serverName.description: Server name to register the connector under.

token.description: Bearer token (auth.type=bearer). May instead be a credential reference — { "ref": "credential", "key": "<key>" } — resolved from the connection's own workspace scope on every connect, so rotating the key needs no config edit. See /config/secrets/.

value.description: Header value (auth.type=header). May instead be a credential reference — { "ref": "credential", "key": "<key>" } — resolved from the connection's own workspace scope on every connect, so rotating the key needs no config edit. See /config/secrets/.

config.description: Opaque provider config (e.g. { audience, scope } for "minted").

headers.description: Arbitrary outgoing headers. Each value is a literal or a credential reference. May instead be a credential reference — { "ref": "credential", "key": "<key>" } — resolved from the connection's own workspace scope on every connect, so rotating the key needs no config edit. See /config/secrets/.

ui.description: UI metadata from the catalog entry's host `_meta` block.

credentialRef.description: A pointer into the credential store instead of a literal secret. The key names a secret set out of band — `manage_connectors set_secret` for a workspace, the file layout for the instance — so nothing about where the value lives appears in config, which is what lets the storage backend change without a config migration.

key.description: Credential-store key, dotted-namespace form, e.g. acme.db_url.
